title: Incompressible Euler equations in 3D bounded domains in a critical space
summary: We consider the 3D incompressible Euler equations in bounded domains $Ω$ with smooth boundary $\partialΩ$. Based on the paper by Iwabuchi, Matsuyama and Taniguchi (2019), we define the Besov space $B^s_{p, q}(A)$ by means of the Stokes operator $A$ with the Neumann boundary condition on $\partialΩ$, and prove unique local existence theorem of strong solution for the initial data in the critical Besov space $B^{\frac52}_{2, 1}(A)$.
